Right wall, directly opposite the elevator: the apartment's tall dark walnut front door with a black smart lock and brass handle. Back wall, facing the camera: a large framed autumn landscape painting of golden trees, hung above a slim dark-wood console table and lit by two brass wall sconces on either side of it. Front wall, behind the camera: a continuation of the stone corridor. The floor is polished pale stone, with clear open floor between the elevator doors and the front door. Light comes from the warm sconces on the back wall and soft downlights in the ceiling. Show only this place as described: the doors, windows and openings it names lead nowhere new, with no other exit, courtyard, corridor or outdoor view added. Light it with the sources the description names, from their direction, at a neutral daylight white balance so that whites are white; only lamps the description names may glow warm.

Avoid: people or silhouettes, readable text, labels, signs with letters or numbers, logos, watermark.
